themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents capable of performing research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including end-to-end research and complex lab research.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools that assist in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, including their capabilities, security implications, and impact on development workflows.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles highlighting specific AI tools designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to literature review and platform development.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discussions around the creation and use of AI-generated or synthetic users for research, testing, and simulation purposes, and the associated trust and identity concerns.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI tools and techniques that condense large volumes of text, such as research papers, earnings calls, and articles, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is used to extract, analyze, and leverage customer data and feedback for product development, marketing, and business growth.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications for analyzing and understanding sentiment expressed in customer feedback, social media, and reviews.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Articles exploring the use of AI in the design process, from generating UI elements and prototypes to streamlining design workflows and evaluating design outputs.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Content related to AI's role in evaluating the usability of products and systems, including testing interfaces and assessing user trust and adoption.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Discussions on how AI can be applied to qualitative research methods, such as interviews and thesis generation, and the associated benefits and concerns.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
